note: Level 1, both label levels read (.sav copied from the batch_662 wallace_2026_s2_profcert cache; sha256 matches; the Study 2 .sps contains no verbal/math text). CODE DERIVATION: SINGLE spec s2_verbalmath.csv = (s2, verbal1->verbal1, verbal2->verbal2, math1->math1, math2->math2), rev flag 0 for all four, no flip, so item IS the source column name: exempt from Step 5b, no verification files. The table carries itemcov_domain (verbal/math) from the script's extra map. ITEM TYPE: these are self-report agreement ratings (domain self-concept and importance), not ability/performance items; no correct_response. Variable labels shipped verbatim: verbal1 = I am good at verbal tasks.; verbal2 = It is important to me that I do well on verbal tasks.; math1 = I am good at math tasks.; math2 = It is important to me that I do well on math tasks. They are the first four columns of the .sav; no lead-in text in the .sav or .sps, so instructions left blank. OPTIONS: all four items value-labelled 1 = '1 - Strongly agree', 2..6 bare digits, 7 = '7 - Strongly disagree'; shipped Strongly agree / Strongly disagree with the number prefixes stripped (sibling convention), 2-6 blank, not padded. The script docstring lists _s2_verbalmath among the 1 = Strongly agree tables. Sanity counts (not required for the exemption): source 838 rows, 838 non-missing per item; live 3352 rows = 838 ids x 4; item resp-count vectors (1..7) source = live exactly: verbal1 91/143/135/137/182/111/39, verbal2 124/142/126/140/140/123/43, math1 102/106/152/136/142/112/88, math2 125/115/119/144/148/122/65. Means 3.79/3.68/3.95/3.84. r(verbal1,verbal2)=0.73, r(math1,math2)=0.69, cross-domain 0.27-0.58, all positive. Direction cross-check (weak but consistent): by .sav gender (1=Male, 2=Female), women score higher on math1 (4.05 vs 3.84) and lower on verbal1 (3.70 vs 3.91), i.e. less agreement they are good at math and more that they are good at verbal under 1 = Strongly agree -- the familiar gender pattern in domain self-concept, consistent with the printed direction. Dictionary Description: Verbal and math items. Rights: study-authored items; no fee, permission, NC or redistribution clause located (silence = permission). Not in instrument_rights_register.csv; no register row written.
public_note: Responses run 1 = Strongly agree to 7 = Strongly disagree, so a higher value means less agreement (e.g. a higher math1 means rating oneself as less good at math tasks).
